svg.text: once per scan, before any run, then frozen
Independent experts traced the same FLAIR:
the primary tracing is the reference
Scale set from the other two raters:
full marks = the other raters vs. the primary
zero point = a fixed margin below the weaker
fixed rules, no human or LLM judge: same mask, same score
· not a copy of the reference
No boundary-distance metrics: 3 mm slices make them unreliable.
Points add up to the quality score; the total sets the grade:
within reference variability: every metric at full marks
finding lesions and outlining them are scored apart
Test: altered copies of the reference
Dilated: every lesion found (F1 = 1.0) but drawn
far too big, so Dice and volume collapse.
Eroded: one-slice lesions vanish, so F1 fails too.
Example: clinical-wmh-segmentation, WMH Challenge 2017, one training case. The raters' own scores are withheld — the thresholds are derived from them — so only their verdicts are shown.
